name: mind
description: Connect Cursor and Grok Bot to MIND — the persistent memory and knowledge-graph layer for AI agents. Query and write memories, documents, the LIFE board, CRM, tasks, and 37 tools through MIND's hosted MCP server at www.m-i-n-d.ai/mcp.

MIND_API_KEY.title: MIND API key
MIND_API_KEY.description: Create one at www.m-i-n-d.ai → Settings → Developer → API Keys. Starts with mind_. It signs every MCP request; revoke it from that same screen any time.
